new_result.name: QFORM-GROUPED-ONEHUB-DENSE-HUB-CURVATURE-v1
new_result.statement: For A[H,I]=p c^T with ||p||_2=1, A_II=D+lambda vv^T, Delta=||v||^2||c||^2-<v,c>^2>0, and Pluecker disjoint-basis mass rho>0, arbitrary same-bank hub curvature A_HH is retained and ||p_Q||_infinity <= 3e [rho |lambda| Delta]^(-1/3). The density is continuous and the same coefficient multiplies every interval length.
new_result.mechanism: Specialize account03/B09 grouped-hub Pluecker smoothing to h=r=1. The entire grouped hub quadratic is kept inside the conditional complex phase amplitude. No projected independence, probability squaring, or square-root decoupling.

required_source_application.conditions: c,v orthonormal flat vectors on two disjoint leaf groups of size m>=2

partner_application.note: p,w are orthonormal projections of the same original hub bank and need not be independent

first_unpaid_implication.name: QFORM-GENERAL-LEAF-CURVATURE-PACKET-OR-CROSSVOLUME-v1
first_unpaid_implication.debt: From s_3(A)>=1, route genuinely general opposite-bank curvature either to a determinant-balanced diagonal-plus-low-rank mixed-frame packet, an already-paid cross-volume/physical-pair/ridge/definite/multi-hyperbolic exit, or a new phase-sensitive estimate retaining the general leaf operator. Do not condition it away or take a worst conditional spectral-density supremum.

negative_boundaries: Do not infer a full QFORM proof from the grouped one-hub theorem.
Do not assume arbitrary A_II can be replaced by diagonal plus one rank-one square.
Do not assume post-rotation independence of grouped hub or leaf projections.
Full-target continuity remains open outside paid branches.
